name: OECD Tax-Benefit Models: net childcare costs

measures.definition: Fees a year for full-time childcare for one child aged 2 or 3, before any public support, national currency.
Fees a year for full-time childcare for two children aged 2 and 3, before any public support.
Net cost a year of full-time childcare for one child, for a two-earner couple on 100% and 67% of the average wage: fees less childcare benefits and tax breaks, plus changes in other benefits.
The same for two children aged 2 and 3.
Net cost a year of full-time childcare for one child, for a single parent on the average wage.
The same for two children aged 2 and 3.

coverage.period: latest model year, the last four years

licence: OECD terms for data (any use, with citation)

rights.edition: OECD Tax-Benefit Models, net childcare costs (DSD_TAXBEN_NCC), 2025
rights.attribution: OECD (2026), Net childcare costs, OECD Tax-Benefit Models, https://www.oecd.org/en/data/indicators/net-childcare-costs.html
notices: Reusers must cite the OECD as above and pass this acknowledgement requirement on to anyone they share the data with.

vetted.notes: The one open, comparable source for childcare after public support; the API answers browsers (CORS open).

caveats: The model prices childcare in one reference place per country (often a large city or a typical municipality), so a city's real fees can differ a lot.
Children aged 2 and 3 only; general child benefits that do not depend on childcare are not in the net cost.
